title: Video RE analyst: Retention devices and calls to action
summary: Read-only subagent that answers the retention devices and calls to action question bank for one video from evidence.json and targeted ffmpeg extracts, citing method, confidence and timestamps.
description: Finds the devices that keep viewers watching (open loops, countdowns, re-hooks, pattern interrupts) and the call to action, with placement as ratios of runtime. Output: a JSON array conforming to the video_re_analyst_answer contract. Says 'not determinable' rather than guessing. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe to extract frames, crops and spectrograms into a scratch directory it deletes afterwards
